title: fix(spec): chart drillDown mode guidance names object-data-table, not TABLE/PIVOT/METRIC
body:
Fixes #20152
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`ChartDrillDownSchema`'s `guidance` entry for `mode` (`packages/spec/src/ui/chart.zod.ts`) told an author who wrote `drillDown.mode` on a chart that the key belonged on a "TABLE / PIVOT / METRIC" widget. Two of those three blocks now refuse the same key on arrival:

- `object-metric` refuses `drillDown.mode` at its TypeScript door since objectui#9002 (PR objectui#10681, merged) — the ruling this card follows (objectui#9002 comment `5643445104`, B).
- `object-pivot` refuses it at its TypeScript door since objectui#10685 (PR objectui#10710, merged).

Measured on objectui `origin/main` (`0896838`): neither `object-metric`'s nor `object-pivot`'s renderer ever read `mode`; only `object-data-table` does (`ObjectDataTableSchema.drillDown` / `plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx`). So the old sentence sent an author straight into a second refusal on two of the three blocks it named, and a stored config that lands on `object-pivot` (no zod mirror there) is silently ignored with no diagnostic.

The guidance now names the one block that actually reads `mode`:

> `mode` (`'filter'` | `'record'`) is objectui's `object-data-table` drill key, not a chart one: …

The reasoning clause and "Delete the key" are unchanged. Its pin at `packages/spec/src/ui/chart.test.ts:707` and the mirror pin at `packages/lint/src/validate-react-page-props.test.ts:1033` moved with the wording.

Out of scope on this card's own evidence (triage note 3, comment `5851546523`): the neighbouring `report` guidance entry ("a METRIC / PIVOT widget capability") is left untouched — its blocks were not remeasured here.

## Premise check (H1)

Re-verified on objectui `origin/main` (`0896838`, PR objectui#10710 merged): `ObjectMetricDrillDownConfig` and the new `ObjectPivotDrillDownConfig` both carry `mode?: never` tombstones; `object-data-table` is the sole reader (`isDrillEnabled` guards it, `'record'` opens the row, `'filter'` turns the drill off). Premise holds in both the pre- and post-#10710 state, so `premise_still_valid: true`.

## Ships, so this carries a changeset

`@objectstack/spec`'s published `files[]` includes both `dist` and `src/**/*.zod.ts`; `chart.zod.ts` ships as source verbatim, and the sentence is also a runtime string in `dist/ui/index.js` / `dist/ui/index.mjs` (measured after a rebuild: 1 occurrence of the new wording in each, 0 of the old "TABLE / PIVOT / METRIC" spelling). `.changeset/20152-chart-drilldown-mode-guidance.md` — `patch`, no accept/reject behaviour changes.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` — all 15 generated artifacts up to date (no regeneration needed for a guidance-text-only change).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` — 541 test files / 15896 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` — clean.

The 5 NOT MEASURED (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:type-check-debt`) each exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` — they read a whole-tree `pnpm build` this local verification's scope does not owe (CI's `Build Core` job covers it).
